headline: Q2FY27 Result Review

highlights: PPOP surged 80.2% YoY to Rs12.3bn and PAT grew 223% YoY and 20% QoQ to Rs7.01bn.
Key Highlights & Investment Rationale:  Margins and Funding: Standalone gold yield improved to 18.0% from 17.7%, while cost of borrowings declined 2bps to 8.73%, expanding spread to 9.3%.
Management indicated 70–80bps of credit cost represents prudential overlay above ECL.
Standalone CRAR was 22.4%, with BVPS at Rs184.1 (+23% YoY).  Outlook: Management guided for 25–30% gold AUM growth in FY27 (19% achieved in H1), yield of 17.5–18.5%, RoA of 3.5–4% and RoE of 15–18%.
